# load data

```{r, echo=FALSE}


library(here)      
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

path_data <- function(file) {
  here("01_data", file)
}

SUBSET_BDI    <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_BDI.xlsx"))    %>% unique()
SUBSET_CESD   <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_CESD.xlsx"))   %>% unique()
SUBSET_HADS   <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_HADS.xlsx"))   %>% unique()
SUBSET_PHQ    <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_PHQ.xlsx"))    %>% unique()
SUBSET_PROMIS <- read.xlsx(path_data("SUBSET_PROMIS.xlsx")) %>% unique()


```

# Datensätze erstellen (Felix)

In drei Schritten results Liste mit "Study", "Variable", "measure_1", "measure_2", "value_1", "value_2", "groupsize" aus allen Fragebogenkombinationen erstellen

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(Hmisc)

BDIxCESD = inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_CESD, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>% unique()
BDIxHADS <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_HADS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
BDIxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
BDIxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_BDI, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxHADS <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_HADS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
CESDxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_CESD, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
HADSxPHQ <- inner_join(SUBSET_HADS, SUBSET_PHQ, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
HADSxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_HADS, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable")) %>%unique()
PHQxPROMIS <- inner_join(SUBSET_PHQ, SUBSET_PROMIS, by = c("Study", "Variable"))%>%unique()


results = list(BDIxCESD, BDIxHADS, BDIxPHQ, 
BDIxPROMIS, CESDxHADS, CESDxPHQ, CESDxPROMIS, HADSxPHQ, 
HADSxPROMIS, PHQxPROMIS)
names(results) =  c("BDIxCESD", "BDIxHADS", "BDIxPHQ", 
"BDIxPROMIS", "CESDxHADS", "CESDxPHQ", "CESDxPROMIS", "HADSxPHQ", 
"HADSxPROMIS", "PHQxPROMIS")

results$BDIxPROMIS$PROMIS_PROMIS.Skala = results$BDIxPROMIS$PROMIS

results2 = lapply(names(results), function(x){
results[[x]]$measure_1 = strsplit(x, "x")[[1]][1]
results[[x]]$measure_2 = strsplit(x, "x")[[1]][2]
results[[x]]$value_1 = results[[x]][, grep("PROMIS", names(results[[x]]))[1]]
results[[x]]$value_2 =  results[[x]][, grep("PROMIS", names(results[[x]]))[2]]
results[[x]]$groupsize = results[[x]][,"groupsize.x"]
results[[x]][, c("Study", "Variable", "measure_1", "measure_2", "value_1", "value_2", "groupsize")]
})

str(results2)
results3 = bind_rows(results2)
results3$groupsize = as.numeric(results3$groupsize)

```


# Figure 2: Blant Altman plot

```{r, echo=FALSE}
results3$m = (results3$value_1 + results3$value_2)/2
results3$d = (results3$value_1 - results3$value_2)
results4 = results3 %>% group_by(measure_1, measure_2) %>% summarise(mean1 = mean(d), wgt_mean = wtd.mean(d, w = groupsize, na.rm = T),
                                                                     sd = sd(d), wtd_sd = sqrt(wtd.var(d, w = groupsize)),
                                                                     lo = mean1-1.96*sd, hi = mean1+1.96*sd,
                                                                     wtd_lo = wgt_mean-1.96*wtd_sd, wtd_hi = wgt_mean+1.96*wtd_sd)


counts <- results3 %>%
  dplyr::count(measure_1, measure_2, name = "n")

Weighted <- ggplot(results3, aes(x = m, y = d)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_grid(measure_1 ~ measure_2) +

  # Horizontale Linien
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wgt_mean)) + 
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wtd_lo), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(data = results4, aes(yintercept = wtd_hi), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +

  # Beschriftungen mittig über den Linien
geom_text(data = results4, 
          aes(x = 50, y = wtd_lo, label = sprintf("%.1f", wtd_lo)), 
          vjust = 0.2, hjust = 2.9, color = "black", size = 4.5) +  
  geom_text(data = results4, 
            aes(x = 50, y = wtd_hi, label = sprintf("%.1f", wtd_hi)), 
            vjust = 0.8, hjust = 2.1, color = "black", size = 4.5) + 
  geom_text(data = results4, 
            aes(x = 50, y = wgt_mean, label = sprintf("%.1f", wgt_mean)), 
            vjust = 0.8, hjust = -1.9, color = "black", size = 4.5) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 70), ylim = c(-15, 15)) +
  labs(
    
    x = "PROMIS T-Score", 
    y = "Difference (d)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),        
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),               
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),                  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14), 
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14) 
  )


Weighted

ggsave("Figure_2.jpeg", plot = Weighted, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```

# Forest Plot

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(gt)
library(patchwork)

print(results4)

# Vergleichsbeschriftungen erzeugen
results4$Comparison_base <- paste(results4$measure_1, "x", results4$measure_2)

# Studienanzahlen definieren
study_counts <- c(
  "BDI x CESD"    = 7,
  "BDI x HADS"    = 9,
  "BDI x PHQ"     = 20,
  "BDI x PROMIS"  = 1,
  "CESD x HADS"   = 14,
  "CESD x PHQ"    = 9,
  "CESD x PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS x PHQ"    = 19,
  "HADS x PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ x PROMIS"  = 6
)

# Gruppenanzahlen definieren
group_counts <- c(
  "BDI x CESD"    = 23,
  "BDI x HADS"    = 32,
  "BDI x PHQ"     = 38,
  "BDI x PROMIS"  = 2,
  "CESD x HADS"   = 36,
  "CESD x PHQ"    = 27,
  "CESD x PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS x PHQ"    = 38,
  "HADS x PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ x PROMIS"  = 6
)

# Kombinierte Comparison-Beschriftung erstellen
results4$Comparison <- paste0(
  results4$Comparison_base,
  " (studies n=", study_counts[results4$Comparison_base],
  ", groups n=", group_counts[results4$Comparison_base], ")"
)

# Nach wgt_mean sortieren und Reihenfolge für Plot fixieren
results4 <- results4[order(results4$wgt_mean), ]
results4$Comparison <- factor(results4$Comparison, levels = results4$Comparison)

# Forestplot erstellen
library(ggplot2)

forestplot <- ggplot(results4, aes(x = wgt_mean, y = Comparison)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = wtd_lo, xmax = wtd_hi), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-10, 10)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in PROMIS T-Scores",
    y = "Comparison"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Plot anzeigen
print(forestplot)

# Optional: Grafik speichern
ggsave("Figure_4.jpeg", plot = forestplot, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in")


```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Labels vorbereiten ----
results4 <- results4 %>%
  mutate(
    est     = wgt_mean,
    ci_lo   = wtd_lo,
    ci_hi   = wtd_hi,
    # Punkt-Schätzer
    est_lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est),
    # CI nur, wenn beide Grenzen endlich sind UND nicht identisch
    ci_lbl  = ifelse(
      is.finite(ci_lo) & is.finite(ci_hi) & (round(ci_lo, 5) != round(ci_hi, 5)),
      sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi),
      "—"
    ),
    # p-Wert
    p_lbl   = case_when(
      is.na(p)   ~ "p = —",
      p < .001   ~ "p < 0.001",
      TRUE       ~ sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
    )
  )

# Sortierung
results4 <- results4[order(results4$wgt_mean), ]
results4$Comparison <- factor(results4$Comparison, levels = results4$Comparison)

# ---- Dynamische Spalten-Positionen ----
x_data_max <- max(c(results4$est, results4$ci_hi), na.rm = TRUE)
x_data_min <- min(c(results4$est, results4$ci_lo), na.rm = TRUE)
gap <- diff(range(c(x_data_min, x_data_max))) * 0.12
if(!is.finite(gap) || gap == 0) gap <- 1.0

x_col1 <- x_data_max + gap*0.8
x_col2 <- x_col1    + gap*1.05
x_col3 <- x_col2    + gap*1.05
x_max  <- x_col3    + gap*0.9
x_min  <- x_data_min - gap*0.2

# ---- Forest Plot ----
forestplot <- ggplot(results4, aes(x = est, y = Comparison)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
                 height = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 21,
             fill = "black", color = "black", stroke = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  # Textspalten
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col1, label = est_lbl), hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col2, label = ci_lbl),  hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col3, label = p_lbl),   hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
  # Header
  annotate("text", x = x_col1, y = Inf, label = "Point estimate",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col2, y = Inf, label = "95% CI",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col3, y = Inf, label = "p-value",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_min, x_max),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in PROMIS T-Scores",
    y = "Comparison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin  = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
  )

print(forestplot)

ggsave("Figure_4_wide.jpeg", plot = forestplot,
       width = 16, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```


forest plot überabreitet
```{r, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Zusatzinfos und Labels vorbereiten (Reihenfolge NICHT ändern)
# --------------------------------------------------
results4 <- results4 %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison_base = paste(measure_1, "x", measure_2),
    n_studies = as.integer(study_counts[Comparison_base]),
    est   = wgt_mean,
    ci_lo = wtd_lo,
    ci_hi = wtd_hi,
    # CI gilt nur, wenn Grenzen endlich und unterschiedlich
    no_ci = !is.finite(ci_lo) | !is.finite(ci_hi) | (round(ci_lo, 6) == round(ci_hi, 6))
  )

# Labels
results4 <- results4 %>%
  mutate(
    est_lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est),
    ci_lbl  = ifelse(no_ci, "—", sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi)),
    p_lbl_raw = case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ "—",
      p < .001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      TRUE     ~ sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
    ),
    # 🔹 Änderung: p-Wert wird bei allen Vergleichen mit nur 1 Studie ausgeblendet
    p_lbl = ifelse(n_studies == 1, "—", p_lbl_raw)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Dynamische Positionen der Spalten (mehr Platz, kein Überlappen)
# --------------------------------------------------
x_data_max <- max(c(results4$est, results4$ci_hi[!results4$no_ci]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_data_min <- min(c(results4$est, results4$ci_lo[!results4$no_ci]), na.rm = TRUE)
rng <- diff(range(c(x_data_min, x_data_max)))
gap <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng * 0.15 else 1.0

x_col1 <- x_data_max + gap * 0.8
x_col2 <- x_col1    + gap * 1.1
x_col3 <- x_col2    + gap * 1.1
x_max  <- x_col3    + gap * 0.9
x_min  <- x_data_min - gap * 0.25

# --------------------------------------------------
# Forest Plot
# --------------------------------------------------
forestplot <- ggplot(results4, aes(x = est, y = Comparison)) +
  # CI nur, wenn vorhanden
  geom_errorbarh(
    data = subset(results4, !no_ci),
    aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
    height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 4.5, shape = 21, fill = "black", color = "black", stroke = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +

  # Textspalten (größer, mit Abstand)
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col1, label = est_lbl), hjust = 0, size = 7.0) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col2, label = ci_lbl),  hjust = 0, size = 7.0) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col3, label = p_lbl),   hjust = 0, size = 7.0) +

  # Header (weiter oben, kein Überlappen)
  annotate("text", x = x_col1, y = Inf, label = "Point estimate",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, fontface = 2, size = 5.2) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col2, y = Inf, label = "95% CI",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, fontface = 2, size = 5.2) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col3, y = Inf, label = "p-value",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, fontface = 2, size = 5.2) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_min, x_max),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in PROMIS T-Scores",
    y = "Comparison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin  = margin(14, 38, 14, 12)
  )

print(forestplot)

# Optional speichern
ggsave("Figure_4_wide.jpeg", plot = forestplot,
       width = 24, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)


```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1) EMMeans aus Mixed Model berechnen
# ----------------------------------------------------------
emm <- emmeans(interceptonlymodel, "questionnaire_pair")
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

# p-Werte aus dem Mixed Model
emm_df$p <- summary(emm)$p.value


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Vergleichsbeschriftungen erzeugen
# ----------------------------------------------------------
emm_df$Comparison_base <- gsub(" ", " x ", emm_df$questionnaire_pair)

study_counts <- c(
  "BDI x CESD"    = 7,
  "BDI x HADS"    = 9,
  "BDI x PHQ"     = 20,
  "BDI x PROMIS"  = 1,
  "CESD x HADS"   = 14,
  "CESD x PHQ"    = 9,
  "CESD x PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS x PHQ"    = 19,
  "HADS x PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ x PROMIS"  = 6
)

group_counts <- c(
  "BDI x CESD"    = 23,
  "BDI x HADS"    = 32,
  "BDI x PHQ"     = 38,
  "BDI x PROMIS"  = 2,
  "CESD x HADS"   = 36,
  "CESD x PHQ"    = 27,
  "CESD x PROMIS" = 1,
  "HADS x PHQ"    = 38,
  "HADS x PROMIS" = 1,
  "PHQ x PROMIS"  = 6
)

emm_df$Comparison <- paste0(
  emm_df$Comparison_base,
  " (studies n=", study_counts[emm_df$Comparison_base],
  ", groups n=", group_counts[emm_df$Comparison_base], ")"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Labels & numerische Spalten
# ----------------------------------------------------------
emm_df <- emm_df %>%
  mutate(
    est     = emmean,
    ci_lo   = lower.CL,
    ci_hi   = upper.CL,
    est_lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est),
    ci_lbl  = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi),
    p_lbl   = ifelse(p < .001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Dynamische x-Positionen für Textspalten
# ----------------------------------------------------------
x_data_max <- max(emm_df$ci_hi)
x_data_min <- min(emm_df$ci_lo)
gap <- (x_data_max - x_data_min) * 0.12

x_col1 <- x_data_max + gap * 0.8
x_col2 <- x_col1    + gap * 1.05
x_col3 <- x_col2    + gap * 1.05
x_max  <- x_col3    + gap * 0.9
x_min  <- x_data_min - gap * 0.2

# Sortieren
emm_df <- emm_df[order(emm_df$est), ]
emm_df$Comparison <- factor(emm_df$Comparison, levels = emm_df$Comparison)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Forestplot (wie Version 2)
# ----------------------------------------------------------
forestplot <- ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = est, y = Comparison)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "black", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +

  geom_text(aes(x = x_col1, label = est_lbl), hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col2, label = ci_lbl), hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_col3, label = p_lbl),  hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +

  annotate("text", x = x_col1, y = Inf, label = "Point estimate",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col2, y = Inf, label = "95% CI",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_col3, y = Inf, label = "p-value",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, fontface = 2, size = 3.4) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_min, x_max),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in PROMIS T-Scores (Mixed Model)",
    y = "Comparison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin  = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
  )
```
